cases.name: test-tokenize-normal-whitespace
cases.description: Verify that a standard input string with multiple words is correctly separated into individual tokens.
cases.expected_behavior: The input string is broken down into a sequence of distinct tokens separated by spaces.

cases.name: test-tokenize-edge-extra-whitespace
cases.description: Verify that leading, trailing, and multiple consecutive whitespace characters do not produce empty tokens.
cases.expected_behavior: Excessive or boundary whitespace is trimmed or ignored, leaving only meaningful argument tokens.

cases.name: test-tokenize-edge-empty-input
cases.description: Verify the behavior when the provided input string contains only whitespace or is completely empty.
cases.expected_behavior: An empty or whitespace-only input results in a zero-length collection of tokens.
